g.text: ARM 3005: short release burst, prolonged local saturation, policy differences
Bars use five printed window averages, not a reconstructed continuous 5 ms curve.
Aligned home contexts overlap and include other requests / spilled work. One run per policy; descriptive only.
S p99 is per task, not per request: submit precedes routing and Folly add; end precedes callback cleanup.
N = unfinished tasks; C = 16 logical CPUs per pool. N/C thresholds are not CPU utilization thresholds.
